title.narrative: ICMPS PAEDIATRIC SURGERY SPECIALIST TEAM - STEPPIN V039 CANBERRA

description.narrative: The Surgeries that we perform are mainly congenital bowel problems such as an absent anus called as anorectal malformations and Hirschsprung’s disease (condition where the bowel has no nerve cells), tumours and Urological Cases such as kidney obstructions, bladder stones, duplicated ureters and abnormal urinary openings. We also operate on any emergency Paediatric surgical problem that may turn up during our visit. We have had stomach duplications with severe bleeding, abdominal wall deficiencies, foreign bodies in bronchus etc. We educate the doctors and nurses about preoperative assessments, post operative care, paediatric life support, burns and stoma care amongst other topics. The team is fully volunteer based and stay for 10 days to 2 weeks depending on the number of cases that require surgery. During each trip we typically operate on 25-30 patients.
